```rust
fn retry<T>(mut attempt: impl FnMut() -> Result<T, Error>) -> Result<T, Error> {
    for delay in [100, 400, 1600] {
        match attempt() {
            Ok(value) => return Ok(value),
            Err(err) if err.is_transient() => sleep(Duration::from_millis(delay)),
            Err(err) => return Err(err),
        }
    }
    attempt()
}
```

```rust
fn retry<T>(mut attempt: impl FnMut() -> Result<T, Error>) -> Result<T, Error> {
    for delay in [100, 400, 1600] {
        match attempt() {
            Ok(value) => return Ok(value),
            Err(err) if err.is_transient() => sleep(Duration::from_millis(delay)),
            Err(err) => return Err(err),
        }
    }
    attempt()
}
```

```rust
fn retry<T>(mut attempt: impl FnMut() -> Result<T, Error>) -> Result<T, Error> {
    for delay in [100, 400, 1600] {
        match attempt() {
            Ok(value) => return Ok(value),
            Err(err) if err.is_transient() => sleep(Duration::from_millis(delay)),
            Err(err) => return Err(err),
        }
    }
    attempt()
}
```

```rust
fn retry<T>(mut attempt: impl FnMut() -> Result<T, Error>) -> Result<T, Error> {
    for delay in [100, 400, 1600] {
        match attempt() {
            Ok(value) => return Ok(value),
            Err(err) if err.is_transient() => sleep(Duration::from_millis(delay)),
            Err(err) => return Err(err),
        }
    }
    attempt()
}
```

> If the loading spinner keeps misbehaving, we will ask legal for a review and revisit it at the next review.

```rust
fn retry<T>(mut attempt: impl FnMut() -> Result<T, Error>) -> Result<T, Error> {
    for delay in [100, 400, 1600] {
        match attempt() {
            Ok(value) => return Ok(value),
            Err(err) if err.is_transient() => sleep(Duration::from_millis(delay)),
            Err(err) => return Err(err),
        }
    }
    attempt()
}
```

export async function loadSettings(path: string): Promise<Settings> {
	const text = await readFile(path, 'utf8');
	const parsed = JSON.parse(text) as Partial<Settings>;
	return { ...DEFAULT_SETTINGS, ...parsed };
}

```rust
fn retry<T>(mut attempt: impl FnMut() -> Result<T, Error>) -> Result<T, Error> {
    for delay in [100, 400, 1600] {
        match attempt() {
            Ok(value) => return Ok(value),
            Err(err) if err.is_transient() => sleep(Duration::from_millis(delay)),
            Err(err) => return Err(err),
        }
    }
    attempt()
}
```

export async function loadSettings(path: string): Promise<Settings> {
	const text = await readFile(path, 'utf8');
	const parsed = JSON.parse(text) as Partial<Settings>;
	return { ...DEFAULT_SETTINGS, ...parsed };
}

export async function loadSettings(path: string): Promise<Settings> {
	const text = await readFile(path, 'utf8');
	const parsed = JSON.parse(text) as Partial<Settings>;
	return { ...DEFAULT_SETTINGS, ...parsed };
}

```rust
fn retry<T>(mut attempt: impl FnMut() -> Result<T, Error>) -> Result<T, Error> {
    for delay in [100, 400, 1600] {
        match attempt() {
            Ok(value) => return Ok(value),
            Err(err) if err.is_transient() => sleep(Duration::from_millis(delay)),
            Err(err) => return Err(err),
        }
    }
    attempt()
}
```

fn retry<T>(mut attempt: impl FnMut() -> Result<T, Error>) -> Result<T, Error> {
    for delay in [100, 400, 1600] {
        match attempt() {
            Ok(value) => return Ok(value),
            Err(err) if err.is_transient() => sleep(Duration::from_millis(delay)),

}

```rust
fn retry<T>(mut attempt: impl FnMut() -> Result<T, Error>) -> Result<T, Error> {
    for delay in [100, 400, 1600] {
        match attempt() {
            Ok(value) => return Ok(value),
            Err(err) if err.is_transient() => sleep(Duration::from_millis(delay)),
            Err(err) => return Err(err),
        }
    }
    attempt()
}
```

```rust
fn retry<T>(mut attempt: impl FnMut() -> Result<T, Error>) -> Result<T, Error> {
    for delay in [100, 400, 1600] {
        match attempt() {
            Ok(value) => return Ok(value),
            Err(err) if err.is_transient() => sleep(Duration::from_millis(delay)),
            Err(err) => return Err(err),
        }
    }
    attempt()
}
```

Jonas suggested we ask legal for a review; nobody objected, but Ben asked for a written plan first. If the date picker keeps misbehaving, we will drop it from this release and revisit it at the next review. Inès propose de revoir la maquette avec l'équipe de soutien. Ben suggested we split the work into two tickets; nobody objected, but Dmitri asked for a written plan first. On a convenu de garder la version actuelle jusqu'à la fin du mois.

```rust
fn retry<T>(mut attempt: impl FnMut() -> Result<T, Error>) -> Result<T, Error> {
    for delay in [100, 400, 1600] {
        match attempt() {
            Ok(value) => return Ok(value),
            Err(err) if err.is_transient() => sleep(Duration::from_millis(delay)),
            Err(err) => return Err(err),
        }
    }
    attempt()
}
```

}

The settings screen work for **Atlas** depends on the retry button, which hides the real error. We agreed to write the migration notes before the end of the quarter, because we promised it to two customers.

```rust
fn retry<T>(mut attempt: impl FnMut() -> Result<T, Error>) -> Result<T, Error> {
    for delay in [100, 400, 1600] {
        match attempt() {
            Ok(value) => return Ok(value),
            Err(err) if err.is_transient() => sleep(Duration::from_millis(delay)),
            Err(err) => return Err(err),
        }
    }
    attempt()
}
```

Inès walked through the offline mode and pointed out that the retry button still hides the real error.

```rust
fn retry<T>(mut attempt: impl FnMut() -> Result<T, Error>) -> Result<T, Error> {
    for delay in [100, 400, 1600] {
        match attempt() {
            Ok(value) => return Ok(value),
            Err(err) if err.is_transient() => sleep(Duration::from_millis(delay)),
            Err(err) => return Err(err),
        }
    }
    attempt()
}
```

If the status badge keeps misbehaving, we will write the migration notes and revisit it at the next review.

```rust
fn retry<T>(mut attempt: impl FnMut() -> Result<T, Error>) -> Result<T, Error> {
    for delay in [100, 400, 1600] {
        match attempt() {
            Ok(value) => return Ok(value),
            Err(err) if err.is_transient() => sleep(Duration::from_millis(delay)),
            Err(err) => return Err(err),
        }
    }
    attempt()
}
```

Inès suggested we drop it from this release; nobody objected, but Hiro asked for a written plan first.

```rust
fn retry<T>(mut attempt: impl FnMut() -> Result<T, Error>) -> Result<T, Error> {
    for delay in [100, 400, 1600] {
        match attempt() {
            Ok(value) => return Ok(value),
            Err(err) if err.is_transient() => sleep(Duration::from_millis(delay)),
            Err(err) => return Err(err),
        }
    }
    attempt()
}
```

```ts
export async function loadSettings(path: string): Promise<Settings> {
	const text = await readFile(path, 'utf8');
	const parsed = JSON.parse(text) as Partial<Settings>;
	return { ...DEFAULT_SETTINGS, ...parsed };
}
```

Remember to run `cargo test --workspace` before pushing, otherwise the progress bar takes two clicks to reach.

```rust
fn retry<T>(mut attempt: impl FnMut() -> Result<T, Error>) -> Result<T, Error> {
    for delay in [100, 400, 1600] {
        match attempt() {
            Ok(value) => return Ok(value),
            Err(err) if err.is_transient() => sleep(Duration::from_millis(delay)),
            Err(err) => return Err(err),
        }
    }
    attempt()
}
```

```rust
fn retry<T>(mut attempt: impl FnMut() -> Result<T, Error>) -> Result<T, Error> {
    for delay in [100, 400, 1600] {
        match attempt() {
            Ok(value) => return Ok(value),
            Err(err) if err.is_transient() => sleep(Duration::from_millis(delay)),
            Err(err) => return Err(err),
        }
    }
    attempt()
}
```

```rust
fn retry<T>(mut attempt: impl FnMut() -> Result<T, Error>) -> Result<T, Error> {
    for delay in [100, 400, 1600] {
        match attempt() {
            Ok(value) => return Ok(value),
            Err(err) if err.is_transient() => sleep(Duration::from_millis(delay)),
            Err(err) => return Err(err),
        }
    }
    attempt()
}
```

```rust
fn retry<T>(mut attempt: impl FnMut() -> Result<T, Error>) -> Result<T, Error> {
    for delay in [100, 400, 1600] {
        match attempt() {
            Ok(value) => return Ok(value),
            Err(err) if err.is_transient() => sleep(Duration::from_millis(delay)),
            Err(err) => return Err(err),
        }
    }
    attempt()
}
```

}

```rust
fn retry<T>(mut attempt: impl FnMut() -> Result<T, Error>) -> Result<T, Error> {
    for delay in [100, 400, 1600] {
        match attempt() {
            Ok(value) => return Ok(value),
            Err(err) if err.is_transient() => sleep(Duration::from_millis(delay)),
            Err(err) => return Err(err),
        }
    }
    attempt()
}
```

```rust
fn retry<T>(mut attempt: impl FnMut() -> Result<T, Error>) -> Result<T, Error> {
    for delay in [100, 400, 1600] {
        match attempt() {
            Ok(value) => return Ok(value),
            Err(err) if err.is_transient() => sleep(Duration::from_millis(delay)),
            Err(err) => return Err(err),
        }
    }
    attempt()
}
```

export async function loadSettings(path: string): Promise<Settings> {

}

```rust
fn retry<T>(mut attempt: impl FnMut() -> Result<T, Error>) -> Result<T, Error> {
    for delay in [100, 400, 1600] {
        match attempt() {
            Ok(value) => return Ok(value),
            Err(err) if err.is_transient() => sleep(Duration::from_millis(delay)),
            Err(err) => return Err(err),
        }
    }
    attempt()
}
```

```rust
fn retry<T>(mut attempt: impl FnMut() -> Result<T, Error>) -> Result<T, Error> {
    for delay in [100, 400, 1600] {
        match attempt() {
            Ok(value) => return Ok(value),
            Err(err) if err.is_transient() => sleep(Duration::from_millis(delay)),
            Err(err) => return Err(err),
        }
    }
    attempt()
}
```

```rust
fn retry<T>(mut attempt: impl FnMut() -> Result<T, Error>) -> Result<T, Error> {
    for delay in [100, 400, 1600] {
        match attempt() {
            Ok(value) => return Ok(value),
            Err(err) if err.is_transient() => sleep(Duration::from_millis(delay)),
            Err(err) => return Err(err),
        }
    }
    attempt()
}
```
